metaDescription: Send a message to PR Per Hour. We review every inquiry carefully.
lead: Share a concise note about your organization and priorities. PR Per Hour reviews every inquiry with care and follows up when we can help.
privacyNote: Your details are used only to respond to this inquiry. We do not publish your message.
successBody: Thank you. Your message was submitted successfully. We will review it — this confirmation does not mean an email reply was sent yet.
validationFullNameMax: Full name must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationEmailMax: Email must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationPhoneMax: Phone must be 50 characters or fewer.
validationOrganizationMax: Organization must be 255 characters or fewer.
validationMessageMax: Message must be 5000 characters or fewer.
errorRateLimited: Too many messages were sent recently. Please wait a minute and try again.
errorForbidden: This request could not be completed.
errorNetwork: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errorServer: The server could not complete this request. Try again later.
